# Analyzer importer inputs

This directory is a byte-pinned miniature of the Foundry importer input. Its
original `.fs` paths and contents are retained so tests exercise and verify the
real `.fs` to `.barista` conversion with exact source provenance.

Generated discovery output belongs under
`project/tests/corpus_staging/analyzer` and uses the `.barista` extension. The
final promoted corpus will also use `.barista`; promotion remains a later
checkpoint.
